_comment: Display config for Country X, a FICTIONAL demonstration country (project-defined, not a primary source). Purpose: demo the full analysis without exposing pilot-country data. The corpus is real published policy-target text pooled from several countries' documents (dev_data_scripts/mock_targets_14aug26.xlsx, built by dev_data_scripts/ingest_countryx_14aug26.py) and de-identified by hand-curated edits listed in that script; no LLM-drafted text anywhere in this config or the corpus. Since October 2026 it also carries a sixth, development document (the Food Security Programme, FSP) and illustrative reported actions (BTR) and reviewed spending (BER), copied from one pilot country's records and de-identified by the replacements listed in python/scripts/build_countryx_layers.py; development plans are where policies pull against each other, and the five plans had none. No NR7 data, no countrySectors or mitigationTaxonomy.
name: Country X
_anchorDocTypeComment: Intentionally omitted. The five convention/strategy documents (climate, adaptation, nature, land) and the food security programme are parallel commitments, not a vision-and-derivatives hierarchy, so the Vision Anchor Coverage view stays off (the same reasoning as for other corpora of parallel plans).
_documentTypesComment: Generic document-type names, not real national documents: Country X is fictional, so fullLabel is the plain convention/strategy document kind and no docKind/published/author/url metadata is set (omitted rather than fabricated). Colors reuse the established cross-country palette (NDC blue, NBSAP green and LDN amber match the other countries; BTR violet and BER blue match the pilot countries' reported-action and budget-line layers); avoids reserved red (#dc2626 political sensitivity) and OTHER grey (#78716c); mutually distinguishable. BTR and BER are the pipeline's pseudo-documents: they never enter the brief's documents.

documentTypes.fullLabel: National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan

_docProvenanceComment: Country X is fictional, so provenance states what each demonstration document actually is instead of citing a national source: real published policy-target text from one real country's document of this kind, de-identified (see ingest_countryx_14aug26.py for every edit).

docProvenance.NDC: Demonstration document for the fictional Country X: real published NDC target text from one country, de-identified. Not any real country's NDC.
docProvenance.NAP: Demonstration document for the fictional Country X: real published National Adaptation Plan target text from one country, de-identified. Not any real country's NAP.
docProvenance.CCS: Demonstration document for the fictional Country X: real published national climate change strategy target text from one country, de-identified. Not any real country's strategy.
docProvenance.NBSAP: Demonstration document for the fictional Country X: real published NBSAP target text from one country, de-identified. Not any real country's NBSAP.
docProvenance.LDN: Demonstration document for the fictional Country X: real published Land Degradation Neutrality strategy target text from one country, de-identified. Not any real country's strategy.
docProvenance.BTR: Demonstration data for the fictional Country X: the mitigation measures and adaptation actions of one pilot country's first Biennial Transparency Report, with places, agencies, programmes and companies replaced by generic terms. Not any real country's report.
docProvenance.BER: Demonstration data for the fictional Country X: the budget lines of one pilot country's BIOFIN Biodiversity Expenditure Review in its two complete years, renumbered and converted to US$ at an indicative rate. Not any real country's spending.
docProvenance.FSP: Demonstration document for the fictional Country X: the measures of one country's published food supply and security programme (a parliament resolution), in the source's own English, de-identified. Not any real country's programme.
